unverified: APRN retitling on June 30, 2027 is confirmed (RCW 18.79.250); whether the renewal CE numbers in WAC 246-840-360 and -450 change with it is not confirmed.
ARNP licence holders and the RN health equity hours: WAC 246-840-222 applies to 'nurses' at the annual RN renewal; no separate ARNP health equity rule was found.

WAC 246-840-360(1)(a) says an active Washington state RN licence while WAC 246-840-990(3) accepts a valid single or multistate RN licence; which governs for a multistate licence issued by another compact state is not confirmed.
Washington state controlled substance registration for individual PA or ARNP prescribers: not researched to a primary source; only DEA and PMP registration confirmed.
Telemedicine training: RCW 43.70.495 sets no hour count; the content is set by the telemedicine collaborative.
